{{Quote|Call sign Two-Moon, mission abort, return to Base One. Call sign Star-Killer, mission abort, return to Base One&hellip;|Jaysa Wise|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Two-Moon''' was the codename of an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] that infiltrated the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facilities on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. After [[Karhel]] was captured, Agent [[Jaysa Wise]] ordered Two-Moon and her other operatives to abort their missions and return to base.
